title: alloispermum sodiroi
intro: Alloispermum sodiroi, commonly known as Ecuadorian Angelica, is a plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, treating fever, and providing relief from respiratory issues, thereby offering potential health benefits such as immune system support. The therapeutic actions of Alloispermum sodiroi include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antifungal properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents like sesquiterpenes and flavonoids.
